answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-work history with stake: each agent must post a bond and build a verifiable record of useful work before its votes count, like a falcon earning altitude climb by climb to reach the summit. New accounts start in a nebula of untrusted identities with zero weight, so spinning up clones buys nothing; only sustained, attested contributions move an agent out of the fog and into influence, while cheaters lose their bond.
